description: T-213 relog recovery (2026-11-17): the arena with the hub BEHIND the player (hubDz -45, D-231), a tamed troll 16 m in front tagged `troll`, the player mounts it through the real alt-key path (rideMount), the ride is checked (ridden, the troll's ZDO marker names the player, the mount file holds the ride), then the player relogs WHILE riding - like the game closing during a ride. Used by ride-relog-recovery and its negative test meta-ride-relog-fails; both run LAST (relog, T-211).
